w:r.w:t: This Shareholders Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on the ___ day of __________ 20___ between:
The Shareholders are the shareholders of:
The purpose of this Agreement is to regulate:
Management and control of the Company;
The issued share capital of the Company shall be held as follows:
The Shareholders acknowledge that Mine Link was conceived, designed and initiated by Bryson Mansoor.
The Company has been established to develop, commercialise and operate the Mine Link platform and related services.
Bryson shall be primarily responsible for:
Jean shall be primarily responsible for:
Bryson shall serve as Chief Executive Officer of the Company.
Jean shall provide technical guidance and support regarding platform development.
Voting rights shall correspond to shareholding percentages.
Except where otherwise required by law, decisions shall be determined by majority vote.
The following matters shall require shareholder approval:
Sale of substantially all Company assets;
Voting shall be determined according to shareholding percentages.
Jean's 15% shareholding shall be subject to vesting.
The purpose of vesting is to ensure continued contribution to the growth and success of the Company.
Jean's 15% shareholding shall vest over a period of sixty (60) months from the Effective Date of this Agreement.
Vesting shall occur monthly over sixty (60) months.
Vesting shall remain conditional upon Jean:
Remaining in good standing with the Company.
before completion of the vesting period:
All unvested shares shall automatically be forfeited;
The Company or Bryson shall have the right to repurchase unvested shares at nominal value.
Any vested shares shall remain owned by Jean subject to:
A Good Leaver shall retain all vested shares.
A Bad Leaver shall immediately forfeit all unvested shares.
Bryson may approve accelerated vesting in writing where:
Subject to available Company cash flow:
These salaries may be adjusted as the Company grows.
No salary shall be guaranteed where Company finances do not permit payment.
Any funds advanced by Bryson to the Company shall be recorded as shareholder loans unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Be deemed an equity contribution unless expressly agreed.
The Company shall maintain accurate records of all shareholder loans.
All intellectual property associated with Mine Link shall belong exclusively to Mine Link (Pty) Ltd.
Neither shareholder shall claim personal ownership of Company intellectual property.
The Shareholders shall keep confidential all:
This obligation survives termination of involvement with the Company.
During involvement with the Company and for twenty-four (24) months after departure, neither shareholder shall:
Use Mine Link confidential information for personal benefit.
This clause shall apply only to the extent enforceable under South African law.
For twenty-four (24) months following departure, a shareholder shall not knowingly solicit:
No shareholder may sell, assign or transfer shares without complying with this Agreement.
Should Jean wish to sell any shares:
Such shares must first be offered to Bryson.
Bryson shall have thirty (30) days to accept.
Only if Bryson declines may the shares be offered to a third party.
The third-party sale price may not be lower than the price offered to Bryson.
If a shareholder dies or becomes permanently incapacitated:
The remaining shareholder shall have the first right to acquire those shares.
The purchase price shall be determined by independent valuation.
If shareholders holding more than 75% of the issued shares approve a sale of the Company:
All shareholders shall be required to participate in the sale.
Bryson's ownership percentage shall satisfy this threshold.
If Bryson sells his shares to a third party, Jean shall have the right to participate in the sale on identical terms and conditions.
Bryson may continue funding the Company at his discretion.
Any shareholder loan shall be recorded separately from equity ownership.
No shareholder shall be obligated to contribute additional capital unless agreed in writing.
Dividends may be declared only where:
The Company remains solvent after distribution.
Dividends shall be distributed according to shareholding percentages.
The Shareholders shall first attempt to resolve disputes through good-faith negotiations.
The dispute shall be referred to mediation.
If mediation fails, the dispute shall be referred to arbitration.
The arbitration shall take place in South Africa and be conducted in English.
If a shareholder ceases involvement with the Company:
Intellectual property ownership shall remain with the Company;
Share transfer provisions shall remain effective.
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Shareholders concerning the ownership, management and operation of Mine Link (Pty) Ltd.
No amendment shall be valid unless reduced to writing and signed by all shareholders.
This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Republic of South Africa.
